cards.ex: The team made an all-out effort to win the championship game.
cards.exUz: Jamoa chempionat o'yinida g'alaba qozonish uchun bor kuchini sarfladi.
cards.uzDef: Butun kuch va imkoniyatlarni ishga solib harakat qilish; maksimal urinish.

cards.ex: She aspires to be a leading expert in her field.
cards.exUz: U o'z sohasida yetakchi mutaxassis bo'lishni orzu qiladi.
cards.uzDef: Yuqori maqsadga erishishni orzu qilmoq, katta narsaga umid qilmoq.

cards.ex: He's single-minded in his pursuit of a medical degree.
cards.exUz: U tibbiyot darajasini olishga qat'iy qaror qilgan.
cards.uzDef: Faqat bitta maqsadga qaratilgan, boshqa narsaga e'tibor bermaydigan.

cards.ex: She gritted her teeth and finished the marathon despite the pain.
cards.exUz: U og'riqqa qaramay, tishini tishiga qo'yib marafonni tugatdi.
cards.uzDef: Qiyinchiliklarga sabr bilan bardosh berish, qattiq harakat qilish.

cards.ex: We'll leave no stone unturned to find a solution to this problem.
cards.exUz: Biz bu muammoni hal qilish uchun barcha yo'llarni sinab ko'ramiz.
cards.uzDef: Muammoni hal qilish yoki maqsadga erishish uchun barcha imkoniyatlarni ishga solmoq.

cards.ex: She's a real self-starter and always comes up with new ideas.
cards.exUz: U haqiqiy tashabbuskor va har doim yangi g'oyalar bilan chiqadi.
cards.uzDef: O'z ishini boshlash uchun boshqalarga muhtoj bo'lmagan odam.

cards.ex: He's on a mission to learn three new languages this year.
cards.exUz: U shu yil uchta yangi tilni o'rganish vazifasini o'z oldiga qo'ygan.
cards.uzDef: Ma'lum bir maqsadga erishish uchun qat'iy harakat qilmoq.

cards.ex: He always goes above and beyond to help his colleagues.
cards.exUz: U doim hamkasblariga yordam berish uchun zo'r berib harakat qiladi.
cards.uzDef: Oddiy talablardan ko'proq harakat qilmoq, juda zo'r ish qilmoq.

cards.ex: She's determined to finish her studies despite the difficulties.
cards.exUz: U qiyinchiliklarga qaramay, o'qishni tugatishga qaror qilgan.
cards.uzDef: Qat'iy niyat bilan biror ishni bajarishga bel bog'lamoq.

cards.ex: We all need to put our shoulder to the wheel if we want to finish the project on time.
cards.exUz: Agar loyihani o'z vaqtida tugatmoqchi bo'lsak, hammamiz mehnatga kirishishimiz kerak.
cards.term: put your shoulder to the wheel
cards.uzDef: Qattiq mehnat qilish, harakatga kirishish, ishga kirishish.

cards.ex: It's important to pursue your dreams, even if they seem impossible.
cards.exUz: Garchi imkonsiz bo'lib tuyulsa ham, orzularni amalga oshirish muhim.
cards.uzDef: O'z orzularingiz sari intilish, orzularni ro'yobga chiqarishga harakat qilish.

cards.ex: This new technology could be a real game-changer for the industry.
cards.exUz: Bu yangi texnologiya sanoat uchun haqiqiy tub burilish bo'lishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Vaziyatni butunlay o'zgartiradigan narsa yoki odam.

cards.ex: She's laser-focused on her career goals.
cards.exUz: U o'zining karyera maqsadlariga diqqatni jamlagan.
cards.uzDef: Faqat bitta narsaga diqqatni jamlagan, e'tiborni boshqa narsaga qaratmaydigan.

cards.ex: He's always reaching for the top in everything he does.
cards.exUz: U har doim hamma narsada eng yuqoriga intiladi.
cards.uzDef: Eng yaxshi bo'lishga harakat qilish, yuqori maqsadlarga intilish.

cards.ex: She took the initiative to organize the charity event.
cards.exUz: U xayriya tadbirini tashkil qilish tashabbusini o'z zimmasiga oldi.
cards.uzDef: Birinchi bo'lib harakat qilish, boshqalardan oldin biror ishni boshlash.

cards.ex: He's got what it takes to go the distance and become a successful entrepreneur.
cards.exUz: Uda muvaffaqiyatli tadbirkor bo'lish uchun kerakli narsalar bor va u oxirigacha yetadi.
cards.uzDef: Qiyinchiliklarga qaramay, boshlangan ishni oxirigacha yetkazish.

cards.ex: Her work is driven by passion for environmental conservation.
cards.exUz: Uning ishi atrof-muhitni muhofaza qilishga bo'lgan ishtiyoqi bilan harakatga keltirilgan.
cards.uzDef: Kuchli istak va qiziqish bilan biror ishni bajarish.

cards.ex: His relentless pursuit of knowledge is truly inspiring.
cards.exUz: Uning bilimga bo'lgan tinimsiz intilishi haqiqatan ham ilhomlantiradi.
cards.uzDef: Maqsadga erishish uchun to'xtovsiz harakat qilish, qat'iyatlilik.

cards.ex: She went above and beyond to help her students succeed.
cards.exUz: U o'z o'quvchilariga muvaffaqiyat qozonishga yordam berish uchun juda yuqori darajada harakat qildi.
cards.uzDef: Kutilganidan yoki talab qilinganidan ko'proq harakat qilish, a'lo darajada.

cards.ex: My teacher always told me to aim for the stars, even if I missed.
cards.exUz: O'qituvchim doim menga, hatto o'tkazib yuborsam ham, yulduzlarga intilishimni aytardi.
cards.uzDef: Katta orzular qilish, yuqori maqsadlarni ko'zlash.

cards.ex: Trying to start a business in this economy is an uphill battle.
cards.exUz: Bu iqtisodiyotda biznesni boshlashga urinish - og'ir kurash.
cards.uzDef: Muvaffaqiyatga erishish qiyin bo'lgan vaziyat, ko'p harakat talab qiladigan kurash.

cards.ex: With the funding secured, we can now go full steam ahead with the project.
cards.exUz: Moliyalashtirish ta'minlanganligi sababli, endi biz loyihani to'liq kuch bilan davom ettirishimiz mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Butun kuch bilan harakat qilish, tez va qat'iy ravishda davom etish.

cards.ex: We're finally starting to make headway on the project.
cards.exUz: Biz nihoyat loyihada muvaffaqiyatga erisha boshladik.
cards.uzDef: Biror ishda oldinga siljish, muvaffaqiyatga erishish.

cards.ex: She's a self-made millionaire who started her business from scratch.
cards.exUz: U o'z biznesini noldan boshlagan va o'zi yaratgan millioner.
cards.uzDef: O'z kuchiga tayanib muvaffaqiyatga erishgan odam.

cards.ex: Our company strives for excellence in everything we do.
cards.exUz: Kompaniyamiz qilayotgan har bir ishda mukammallikka intiladi.
cards.uzDef: Eng yaxshi natijalarga erishishga harakat qilish, mukammal bo'lishga intilish.

cards.ex: We just have to tough it out until things get better.
cards.exUz: Vaziyat yaxshilanmaguncha, biz shunchaki qiyinchilikka chidashimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Qiyinchiliklarga bardosh berish, og'ir vaziyatni sabr bilan o'tkazish.

cards.ex: He was considered an underachiever in high school, but he excelled in college.
cards.exUz: U o'rta maktabda kam natijali deb hisoblangan, ammo kollejda a'lo o'qidi.
cards.uzDef: Qobiliyati bor, lekin kutgan natijaga erisha olmagan odam.

cards.ex: She passed her exam with flying colors.
cards.exUz: U imtihondan a'lo baholar bilan o'tdi.
cards.uzDef: Katta muvaffaqiyat bilan, a'lo natijalar bilan.

cards.ex: It's important to stay determined even when things get tough.
cards.exUz: Ishlar qiyinlashganda ham qatiy bo'lish muhim.
cards.uzDef: O'z maqsadiga erishish uchun qatiy va ishonchli bo'lish.

cards.ex: Her strong work ethic is admired by everyone.
cards.exUz: Uning kuchli ish etikasi hammaga yoqadi.
cards.uzDef: Mehnatga bo'lgan munosabat, mehnatsevarlik, mas'uliyatlilik.
